visual.general_description: Multimodal assessment and management summary diagram.
visual.detailed_description: Light-blue diagram headed “Multimodal Assessment and Personalized Management in a Recreational Athlete with HCM”. Left: blue athlete with a round weight, “38-year-old recreational athlete”, “Previously competitive; HCM diagnosed at 19”. Center “Multimodal Evaluation” groups an ECG sketch (“LVH + T-wave inversion”), a blue heart icon (“Asymmetric septal hypertrophy, LVEF 45–50%”), scanner icon (“17% Fibrosis”) and DNA icon (“Two MYBPC3 variants (1 likely pathogenic)”). Right “Management & Outcome” shows an ICD icon with “Subcutaneous ICD implanted” and a green check with “Recreational activity allowed”. Two solid gray rightward arrows connect the left, central and right groups; “Risk Stratification” appears at bottom.

evidence.quote:
Figure 3
Cardiac magnetic resonance showing late gadolinium enhancement in the basal septal and mid-septal and anterior segments, involving 17% of the myocardial mass.

Figure 3
Cardiac magnetic resonance showing late gadolinium enhancement in the basal septal and mid-septal and anterior segments, involving 17% of the myocardial mass.

To refine phenotypic characterization, a CMR imaging was performed. Cardiac magnetic resonance confirmed preserved biventricular systolic function (LVEF 59%) and asymmetric septal hypertrophy with a maximum thickness of 19 mm. In addition, marked biatrial enlargement was evident, with a left atrial volume index of 79 mL/m² and right atrial area of 25 cm². Importantly, extensive diffuse late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) was detected in the basal and mid-septal and anterior segments, involving 17% of the myocardial mass (Figure 3).
